question: The actions of the Belarusian government to punish opposition by removing citizenship and stopping the possibility of obtaining documents abroad poses a serious problem for the hundreds of thousands of Belarusians who have fled to Europe in exile. These problems also affect their children born since moving to Europe, as they have no possibility of obtaining official documents or citizenship from Belarus. 1.
Is the Commission aware of the number of children born to Belarusian parents who are unable to obtain official documents from their country of residence in the EU?

In answers to previous Written Questions (E-000718/20241, E-002303/20242, E003004/20263), the Commission has referenced its work in cooperation with the European External Action Service on promoting best practices among Member States. Can the Commission describe further the concrete results or improvements achieved as a result of this coordination?
Does the Commission plan any additional measures to coordinate a common response to ensure that no children end up in vulnerable situations?
